ENIT
Villages · 8 min

The last light on the harbour

Arrive before nine and the piazza belongs to the fishermen mending nets, not to the day trippers stepping off the train.

By noon the boats are out and the harbour wall is warm enough to sit on; the light turns gold an hour before sunset.

Walk up to the tower for the view, then down again for a slice of focaccia still warm from the oven.
